steps.text: The banner above the map says how many meters are not on it yet. Click "Fix the addresses" to open the queue of meters to reposition.
steps.title: Fix the addresses

steps.text: The dialog lists exactly the meters the map cannot place: those with no coordinates at all, and also those pinned only to the centre of their municipality.
steps.title: The repair queue

steps.text: Click a row to load its address into the form on the right. Repairs are made one meter at a time.
steps.title: Pick a meter

steps.text: OptimCE queries the federal BeSt Address register. This address matches nothing there, which is why the meter is missing from the map.
steps.title: Address not found

steps.text: Move on to another meter in the list.
steps.title: Another meter

steps.text: Go back to the meter whose address was not found, to correct it.
steps.title: Back to the meter

steps.text: Type the first words of the real address. The suggestions come straight from the official Belgian address register.
steps.title: Search for the right address

steps.text: Click the matching suggestion. The five detailed fields are filled with the register's official spelling.
steps.title: Choose the suggestion

steps.text: The green message confirms the address is precisely located: the meter will appear on the map once the repair is saved.
steps.title: Address located

steps.text: "Save and next" applies the fix and moves on to the next meter in the queue, without closing the dialog.
steps.title: Save and continue

steps.text: Close the window when you are done.
steps.title: Close

steps.text: Back on the map, the banner has gone down: the repaired meter is now placed, and only the one pinned to its municipality centre remains.
steps.title: The map is up to date
